_comment: The registry of callable models. This file IS the allowlist — the router refuses any model not listed here (and provenance.mjs refuses any listed model whose family isn't approved). Endpoints are OpenAI-compatible; anything that speaks that API works: Ollama (local), vLLM, LM Studio, or a hosted gateway (Mistral La Plateforme, Together, Fireworks, Groq, NVIDIA NIM). base_url_env names the env var holding the endpoint; api_key_env the key (omit for keyless local).
_tool_calling_note: For the agentic --tools path prefer a model post-trained for function calling: granite-3.3-8b (IBM, built for tool use + RAG), gpt-oss-20b, or llama3.1-8b. Reliability comes from constrained decoding (response_format json_schema, set per model by supports_json_schema) plus a tool-trained model — NOT from fine-tuning. Fine-tune later (Tinker LoRA on llama3.1-8b) only once BARTLE_TRACE=1 has logged a corpus and a Bartle-eval shows a gap prompting+constraints didn't close.
_pricing_note: price_in / price_out are USD per 1,000,000 tokens, EDITABLE estimates — verify against your provider's current rates, the router reads these fields to compute per-run cost. Local models are 0. 'Rent and measure' mode: run everything hosted, e.g. --researcher gpt-oss-120b --skeptic mistral-small; the workflow prints and ledgers cost per subhazard so you can price the backlog before buying hardware.

gpt-oss-20b.note: OpenAI gpt-oss-20b, Apache 2.0. Local default via Ollama on the spare machine.

granite-3.3-8b.note: IBM Granite 3.3 8B. Small local tier / CPU-friendlier alternative.

llama3.1-8b.note: Meta Llama 3.1 8B. Tinker LoRA fine-tune base.

mistral-small.note: Mistral Small. Used as the SKEPTIC by default — different lineage from the gpt-oss researcher gives genuine adversarial diversity.

gpt-oss-120b.note: OpenAI gpt-oss-120b via any hosted OpenAI-compatible gateway. Boss tier.

llama-3.3-70b.note: Meta Llama 3.3 70B via any hosted OpenAI-compatible gateway (Groq/Together/Fireworks). Strong+cheap hosted researcher.
